titleEn: AI may quickly generate ideas, but working with people leads to more creative ones
titleZh: 人工智能生成想法很快，但与他人合作可能更有创造力
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: The productivity gains of generative AI are often touted as the main reason for its rapid adoption. Much like how a calculator can instantly solve mathematical equations too long for the human brain to compute, generative AI can help someone quickly summarize long articles and draft emails.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式人工智能的生产力提高通常被吹捧为其快速采用的主要原因。就像计算器可以立即解决人类大脑无法计算的数学方程一样，生成式人工智能可以帮助人们快速总结长篇文章和起草电子邮件。

paragraphs.en: But beyond productivity, a key question remains: How is AI affecting quintessentially human activities, such as collaboration and creativity?
paragraphs.zh: 但除了生产力之外，一个关键问题仍然存在：人工智能如何影响典型的人类活动，例如协作和创造力？

paragraphs.en: As cognitive scientists who study creativity, we recently conducted an experiment that explored how working with AI – rather than humans – affects originality and other aspects of creativity.
paragraphs.zh: 作为研究创造力的认知科学家，我们最近进行了一项实验，探索与人工智能而不是人类合作如何影响原创性和创造力的其他方面。

paragraphs.en: Speedy and wordy doesn’t mean creative
paragraphs.zh: 快速和冗长并不意味着创造性

paragraphs.en: Creativity is often tied to what cognitive scientists call “divergent thinking.” One way of measuring divergent thinking is to ask someone to come up with a range of uses for a common item, such as a brick or a book. This is known as the alternate uses task.
paragraphs.zh: 创造力通常与认知科学家所说的“发散性思维”有关。衡量发散性思维的一种方法是让某人想出一个常见物品的一系列用途，比如一块砖或一本书。这被称为交替用途任务。

paragraphs.en: Researchers then compare the number of ideas and the originality of these ideas to assess creative capacity.
paragraphs.zh: 然后，研究人员比较这些想法的数量和这些想法的原创性，以评估创造力。

paragraphs.en: Large language models appear to have the “number of ideas” part down pat: They can generate many more ideas than humans can. This ability to produce more – and produce that high volume more quickly – partially explains why more than half of new articles online are now generated by AI.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型似乎在“创意数量”方面做得很好：它们可以产生比人类多得多的创意。这种产生更多创意的能力--而且产生的速度更快--部分解释了为什么现在网上超过一半的新文章都是由人工智能产生的。

paragraphs.en: These texts, however, are often verbose, with redundant information. Researchers who tested 12 AI chatbots across different companies on thousands of factual questions found that their answers were often many times longer than human-written answers, with the actual answer making up only about 42% of the text. The rest was largely extra padding: repetitive information, unnecessary background details and explanations that went into too much detail or veered off topic.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这些文本往往是冗长的，有冗余的信息。研究人员对不同公司的12个人工智能聊天机器人进行了数千个事实问题的测试，发现它们的答案往往比人类书面答案长很多倍，实际答案只占文本的42%左右。其余的大部分是额外的填充：重复的信息，不必要的背景细节和解释，进入太多的细节或偏离主题。

paragraphs.en: Large language models also seem to struggle with the originality of their outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型似乎也在与其输出的原创性作斗争。

paragraphs.en: An ‘original’ idea – again and again
paragraphs.zh: 一个“原创”的想法-一次又一次

paragraphs.en: In our research, we compared the results of people working on the alternate uses task with another person to those who collaborated with ChatGPT on the same task. We randomly assigned 208 participants to work with either AI or another person.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的研究中，我们比较了与另一个人一起完成交替使用任务的人和与ChatGPT合作完成同一任务的人的结果。我们随机分配了208名参与者与AI或另一个人一起工作。

paragraphs.en: We found that compared with two people taking turns together, people working with ChatGPT wrote longer responses on the alternate uses task. But human pairs came up with more creative ideas than the humans working with ChatGPT.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，与两个人轮流在一起相比，使用ChatGPT的人在交替使用任务中写的回复更长。但人类配对比使用ChatGPT的人想出了更多创造性的想法。

paragraphs.en: We also found that the ideas people came up with when working with other people tended to be more distinct and diverse than those who worked with large language models. Individual AI suggestions could be quite creative – using a book as a sound dampener, for example – but ChatGPT presented that same idea across many separate sessions, making its overall pool of ideas more homogeneous.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还发现，与使用大型语言模型的人相比，人们在与其他人合作时产生的想法往往更加独特和多样化。人工智能的个人建议可能非常有创意-例如，使用一本书作为声音破坏者-但ChatGPT在许多单独的会话中提出了相同的想法，使其整体想法池更加同质化。

paragraphs.en: Other studies have highlighted the homogeneity of generative AI’s outputs. One group of researchers found that using AI repeatedly over time to generate images often results in bland, generic pictures – what they call “visual elevator music.” Other studies have found that although AI may help an individual write a more creative story when compared with their preexisting work, AI-assisted writing as a whole, across all users, tends to be more similar.
paragraphs.zh: 其他研究也强调了人工智能生成的结果的同质性。一组研究人员发现，随着时间的推移，反复使用人工智能生成图像往往会产生平淡、通用的图片--他们称之为“视觉电梯音乐”。其他研究发现，尽管人工智能可能会帮助一个人写一个比他们之前的作品更有创意的故事，但人工智能辅助写作作为一个整体，在所有用户中，会变得更相似

paragraphs.en: All of this makes sense when you think about how large language models work. After being trained on massive sets of texts, large language models predict the next most likely words. Because their training processes were similar, different large language models, whether it’s ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, tend to have similar cadences, diction, syntax and suggestions – particularly when compared with the work of two random human writers.
paragraphs.zh: 当你思考大型语言模型的工作原理时，所有这些都是有意义的。在接受大量文本集的训练后，大型语言模型预测下一个最有可能的单词。因为它们的训练过程是相似的，不同的大型语言模型，无论是ChatGPT，Claude还是Gemini，往往都有相似的节奏，措辞，语法和建议-特别是当与两个随机的人类作家的作品相比时。

paragraphs.en: In other words, generative AI’s ideas may seem unique in a vacuum. But if everyone’s using AI, the ideas and writing style start to converge.
paragraphs.zh: 换句话说，生成式AI的想法在真空中似乎是独一无二的。但如果每个人都在使用AI，想法和写作风格就会开始趋同。

paragraphs.en: Creative collaboration is a long game
paragraphs.zh: 创造性合作是一场漫长的游戏

paragraphs.en: Finally, we also found that the creativity benefits of working with another person became even stronger as the collaboration progressed.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们还发现，随着合作的进展，与另一个人合作的创造力优势变得更加强大。

paragraphs.en: Ideas can be measured through semantic distance, which is a way of quantifying how distinct individual concepts are. Over time, interacting with other humans seems to result in larger semantic distance than interacting with a chatbot. In other words, people may traverse more creative terrain when collaborating with other people. Meanwhile, the tendency for ideas to converge in chatbot-assisted brainstorming could accumulate, potentially narrowing the range of ideas people explore over the course of a long period of time.
paragraphs.zh: 想法可以通过语义距离来衡量，语义距离是一种量化个体概念差异的方法。随着时间的推移，与其他人互动似乎比与聊天机器人互动产生更大的语义距离。换句话说，人们在与其他人合作时可能会穿越更有创造性的领域。同时，在聊天机器人辅助的头脑风暴中，想法趋同的趋势可能会积累，潜在地缩小了人们在很长一段时间内探索的想法范围。

paragraphs.en: This is important because many creative projects involve long-term engagement.
paragraphs.zh: 这一点很重要，因为许多创意项目都涉及长期参与。

paragraphs.en: For example, to launch a new product, researchers have found that it takes an average of 27 months to go from the initial idea to the finished product. More innovative products can take as long as 54 months.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，要推出一款新产品，研究人员发现，从最初的想法到最终产品，平均需要27个月的时间，更有创新的产品可能需要长达54个月。

paragraphs.en: Chat-human before you ChatGPT
paragraphs.zh: ChatGPT之前的聊天-人类

paragraphs.en: If you want to work with a chatbot, how can you preserve your creativity in the face of AI’s tendency toward homogeneity?
paragraphs.zh: 如果你想和聊天机器人一起工作，面对人工智能的同质化趋势，你如何保持你的创造力？

paragraphs.en: Some research suggests using what’s called “persona prompting.” Like talking to other people with different perspectives, users could provide an extensive prompt to give chatbots a pretend personality that can simulate different types of people. For example, you might prompt it to respond as if it is “a male college professor from India who is an expert in teaching” or “a 58-year-old female founder of a construction company.”
paragraphs.zh: 一些研究建议使用所谓的“角色提示”。就像与其他具有不同观点的人交谈一样，用户可以提供广泛的提示，让聊天机器人拥有可以模拟不同类型人的假装个性。例如，你可能会提示它回答，好像它是“一个来自印度的男性大学教授谁是教学专家”或“58岁，一个建筑公司的女创始人

paragraphs.en: Researchers found that while this persona prompting increased ChatGPT’s idea diversity, the overall range of ideas still fell short of that produced by human writers. These findings echo other recent research suggesting that chatbots are poor simulators of human personality.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人员发现，虽然这个角色促进了ChatGPT的想法多样性，但整体想法范围仍然低于人类作家。这些发现与最近的其他研究相呼应，这些研究表明聊天机器人是人类个性的拙劣模拟器。

paragraphs.en: If you need help with a creative task, we suggest going back to the basics: Chat with a person before chatting with AI. They’ll have idiosyncratic personal experiences that can’t be captured by a large language model that’s trained to generate average responses.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你需要帮助完成一项创造性任务，我们建议你回到最基本的：在与人工智能聊天之前先与一个人聊天。他们会有独特的个人体验，而这种体验是经过训练以生成平均响应的大型语言模型无法捕捉的。

paragraphs.en: Composing a sentence, however modest, is a creative act, whether it’s in a text to a friend or a wedding speech. As AI is integrated into workflows, it’s important to remember that other people can still be a valuable resource. Work completed in collaboration with other humans feels more meaningful.
paragraphs.zh: 无论是在给朋友的短信中还是在婚礼致辞中，写一句话，无论多么谦虚，都是一种创造性的行为。随着人工智能融入工作流程，重要的是要记住，其他人仍然可以成为宝贵的资源。与其他人合作完成的工作感觉更有意义。

paragraphs.en: They might not respond as quickly or as comprehensively. But chances are they’ll have something more interesting to say.
paragraphs.zh: 他们可能不会很快或全面地做出回应，但很有可能他们会说一些更有趣的事情。
